correctness.rationale: A four-edge rooted ultrametric derivation yields the exact affine sign formula with the parameter h/H. value.rationale: Expected PD rarefaction curves are a standard tool to compare biodiversity at standardized sampling effort. An exact, sharp first double-ranking reversal at census seven, on one shared nondegenerate ultrametric tree with strictly positive counts, quantifies a meaningful finite limitation of sampling-depth robustness. The classification exposes three distinct mechanisms and their exact feasible branch ratios; it is more informative than an arbitrary example or textbook formula substitution.
